name: The Pioneers
desc:
**The Pioneers**, also known as the Pioneer Divers, were the first ever [Divers](faction:the_divers) to descend into [the Depths](location:the_depths). They used a cave system, which went deep into the Depths. All of them tragically perished, most got caught off-guard by the beasts of [the Depths](location:the_depths), but those who successfully came back to the Surface perished shortly after stepping out of the caves, due to a concept, known as "boundary death".

The concept of [the Depths boundary](location:the_depths) was able to be further expanded upon thanks to the expedition.

All of the Pioneer Divers' names were carved in the tremendously-sized monoliths in a vast memorial hall within [the Citadel of Markor](faction:the_citadel_of_markor) by the Memorial Masons.
additional_info: -   The Song of Fathoms / Oscillation was commissioned in the name of their expedition by [The High Convocation](faction:the_high_convocation) and performed at the ceremony by the Scholars' Orchestra of the Scholars of Markor.
